svg.title: iOS · Interval grading viewer · main buttons · portrait
svg.desc: Mirrors App/PhotoViewerView.swift (`phoneEditorBody`, `phoneFoot`, `phoneTimelineCard`, `groupSelection`, `nonNeutralGroups`) and App/EditorControls/EditorGroupBar.swift (style .phone) with App/GradeTimelineView.swift — the Editor tab of an INTERVAL shoot with NO group open: what the screen looks like on arrival and after every ✓ / ✕. New 2026-09-13 for the editor controls redesign (section 6 lock-in, boards 2a + 6a). LAYOUT (2a / 6a, `phoneEditorBody`): the picture fills the safe area (59 top / 34 bottom on this canvas) and is fitted into it — a 3:4 portrait shoot spans the width and centres vertically, 176…700 — and everything else floats over it. `touchChrome`: the 36 pt back disc at (16, 71) and the `EditorTabPill` top-right (right 16, top 74: 12 pt of vertical padding under the safe area, the 30 pt pill centred on the 36 pt disc) — the boards draw both at top 60, the app sits them 11 pt lower. The pill is rgba(28,28,30,.85) over material, radius 18, 12 pt semibold, the selected tab amber with black text, the rest amber on ink; Frames appears only on a shoot with more than one frame. The foot (`phoneFoot`) is bottom-anchored on the safe area: the timeline card where `hasTimeline`, then EITHER the six main buttons (`EditorGroupBar(.phone)`) OR the open group's sheet (`PhotoAdjustmentsPanel(layout: .phone)`) — one or the other, the sheet needs the buttons' room. The sheet: 22 pt top corners, rgba(28,28,30,.86) over material running under the home indicator, padded 12 top / 16 sides / 0 bottom, 10 pt between rows, shadow up; header = title 15 pt semibold white · 6 pt dot (accent when the group holds a value or a travelling field, clear otherwise so the row never reflows) · spacer · ✕ 32 pt white 10 % (reverts to the snapshot `openPanel(for:)` took) · ✓ 32 pt amber (keeps and closes). Long-press the title for Reset <group> / Reset all adjustments. The 1:1 toggle (`zoomControls`, 32 pt black 45 %) sits bottom-trailing of the picture pane 12 pt in, lifted above the foot by its measured height; it exists only while `hasPixelsToReveal`, so a small source shows none. The readouts print the app's own formats (`%+.2f`, `%+.0f`, unsigned 0…100, Kelvin) with an ASCII hyphen-minus where the boards typeset U+2212. THIS CANVAS: the timeline card (6a, `phoneTimelineCard`) sits on the picture's foot — margins 12 at the sides and 8 below, padding 10 / 12 / 6, radius 16, black 60 % over material — holding the `EditorMarqueeBadge` (20 pt, black 50 %, 11 pt semibold white: kind · length · frame count, a part the project cannot say is left out) and, 20 pt under it, the strip on its FULL metrics: 30 pt play disc (#1C1C1E, amber play.fill), 12 pt gap, the 3 pt rail at white 18 %, the 11 pt amber moments with their 2 pt #C36A00 ring at 10 / 52 / 86 %, the 3×22 white playhead at 30 % drawn under them, the elapsed bubble (16 pt, #2B2B2E 90 %, 10 pt semibold) held between 7 % and 93 % of the track with its foot over the playhead's head, the h:mm:ss clocks 10.5 pt #8E8E93 under the rail's ends, and the two 30 pt one-frame steps 8 pt apart after the track — centred on the strip's whole 45 pt (transport + labels), which is why they sit 7.5 pt below the play disc. The steps take their width out of the track. Under the card, `EditorGroupBar(.phone)`: a black bar padded 8 top / 10 sides, six 58 pt cells spread edge to edge (5 pt apart on this width), each an SF Symbol at 20 pt (photo.stack · sun.max · circle.lefthalf.filled · sparkles · triangle · crop.rotate), a 10 pt semibold label and a 4 pt dot — accent when the group holds a value or a travelling field (here Presets: Natural is not Original; Light and Color: the keyframed exposure, highlights, shadows, white and vibrance), clear otherwise so the cells never change height. No cell is highlighted while no panel is open; a tap opens that group's sheet in the bar's place and takes the ✓/✕ snapshot; the open cell is amber on amber 14 % in the landscape rail, where the bar stays visible. The 34 pt home-indicator zone under the cells is the bar's own black. Staged by LL_EDITOR=latest LL_VIEWER=1 LL_KEYFRAMES=sunset with no LL_SECTIONS; the reference shoot read 6 min 4 s · 183 frames, this file keeps the boards' 2 h 14 min · 58 frames and 0:40:12 / 2:14:00 clocks.
svg.text: iOS · Interval grading viewer · main buttons · portrait · 393×852 pt
mirrors PhotoViewerView phoneFoot — timeline card + EditorGroupBar(.phone), no group open · LL_EDITOR=latest LL_KEYFRAMES=sunset
